meta.title: Synthetic demonstration dataset
meta.description: FICTIONAL data used only to exercise the application's features (routes with timed waypoints, branching, settlements with population timelines, assimilation, ranges, regions, events, antimeridian crossing). Group names, numbers, places and dates are invented and have no historical meaning.

groups.name: Alpha culture (fictional)
groups.description: Synthetic parent group used to test branching and settlement hand-over.

groups.name: Beta herders (fictional)
groups.description: Synthetic group used to test nomadic back-and-forth movement and political regions.

groups.name: Gamma seafarers (fictional)
groups.description: Synthetic group used to test long coastal routes without population estimates.

groups.name: Delta highlanders (fictional)
groups.description: Synthetic group used to test displacement and polygon settlements.

groups.name: Epsilon islanders (fictional)
groups.description: Synthetic group used to test routes crossing the antimeridian.

settlements.name: Origin Basin settlement
settlements.description: Synthetic source population. Shrinks while the western and southern migrations depart (dedup test: migrations draw from this settlement).

settlements.name: Western Plain settlement
settlements.description: Founded by the western branch, grows (radius keyframes) and is assimilated into the Beta herders around 1200 BCE (colour transition test).

settlements.name: Southern Coast settlement
settlements.description: Defined-boundary settlement that declines and disperses.

settlements.name: Far Western Valley settlement
settlements.description: Population given only as a wide range with speculative confidence.

settlements.name: Highland polygon settlement
settlements.description: Polygon-shaped settlement overlapping the Origin Basin area (coexistence test); displaced around 900 BCE.

settlements.name: Trading post (no population data)
settlements.description: Settlement without any population estimate: drawn as an area only.

migrations.name: Westward movement (fictional)
migrations.description: Main westward wave with timed waypoints: the leading edge reaches the river crossing by 2320 BCE and the marsh by 2200 BCE.

migrations.name: Southward movement (fictional)
migrations.description: Smaller southern branch; linked to the western wave with `parent` for the branch dedup check.

migrations.name: Onward to the far west (fictional)
migrations.description: Conjectural route (dashed) from a settlement founded by an earlier migration.

migrations.name: Seasonal return east (fictional)
migrations.description: Return movement whose arrived dots persist until 1300 BCE and then vanish.

migrations.name: Herders press into the plain (fictional)
migrations.description: Arrives as the Western Plain settlement assimilates into Beta.

migrations.name: Coastal voyage (fictional, no population estimate)
migrations.description: Long coastal route with no population figure: rendered as a flowing stream with a leading marker instead of dots.

migrations.name: Island hopping east (fictional)
migrations.description: Route crossing the antimeridian (180°) to test longitude unwrapping.

migrations.name: Trans-continental trek (fictional)
migrations.description: Very long, slow movement with a wide corridor and heavily staggered departures.

regions.name: Beta political control (fictional)
regions.description: Political control footprint, deliberately NOT a population: drawn hatched without dots.

events.name: Alpha splits west / south
events.description: Synthetic split event marking the start of the two branches.
